output.sql:
SELECT o.sales_rep_id AS employee_number, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND o.sales_rep_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.sales_rep_id
ORDER BY revenue DESC, o.sales_rep_id
LIMIT 3
output.explanation: This returns the three sales reps with the highest net revenue from revenue-counting orders (is_revenue) dated in 2025. The tables have no separate employee number column, so I assumed it means sales_rep_id. If your employee numbers are a different HR identifier, these values won't match them. Orders without a sales rep are excluded, and ties are broken by the lower ID.
